title: 5 January 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the 10th night of Another Beatles Christmas Show, which ran from 24 December 1964 to 16 January 1965 at London’s Hammersmith Odeon. There were no performances on 3 or 10 January.

There were two shows on this night, with guest performers including Freddie And The Dreamers, Sounds Incorporated, Elkie Brooks, The Yardbirds, Michael Haslam, The Mike Cotton Sound and Ray Fell. The compère was Jimmy Savile.

The Beatles appeared in two sketches, one with Freddie Garrity of Freddie And The Dreamers, and another with Jimmy Savile. They closed the shows with an 11-song set: ‘Twist And Shout’, ‘I’m A Loser’, ‘Baby’s In Black’, ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, ‘Honey Don’t’, ‘I Feel Fine’, ‘She’s A Woman’, ‘A Hard Day’s Night’, ‘Rock And Roll Music’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 13 October 2021

Also on this day...

  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: National Exhibition Centre, Birmingham
  • 1984: US single release: Nobody Told Me by John Lennon
  • 1978: Mixing: Café On The Left Bank, Name And Address, Famous Groupies by Wings
  • 1977: Mixing: Seaside Woman by Suzy And The Red Stripes
  • 1976: Recording: Must Do Something About It, She’s My Baby by Wings
  • 1972: John Lennon and Yoko Ono meet John Sinclair
  • 1972: Recording: Attica State, Sisters O Sisters by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1970: Glyn Johns compiles the second Get Back album
  • 1970: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give a press conference in Aalborg, Denmark
  • 1967: Recording: Penny Lane, Carnival Of Light
  • 1966: Recording: overdubs for The Beatles At Shea Stadium
  • 1964: Radio: The Public Ear
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Museum Hall, Bridge of Allan, Scotland
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
